headline: Cipher Mining Reports $31 Million Q3 Profit Supported by Accounting Gain
summary: Cipher Mining reported a third-quarter profit of $31 million, supported by a $127 million accounting gain, despite a 63% drop in revenue as it begins pivoting toward artificial intelligence.
why: Cipher Mining is an industrial-scale Bitcoin mining company that is expanding into data center hosting for high-performance computing and AI workloads.

impacts.name: Cipher Mining Inc.
impacts.why: Cipher Mining reported its third-quarter financial results, showing lower revenue alongside an accounting gain.
